description: Customer service and agentic commerce platform unifying conversations, customer profiles, and omnichannel support.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 and API access tokens/bearer tokens for integration authentication.
credential_notes: Gladly requires contacting sales or entering an enterprise contract for account access; no self-serve free developer sandbox tier is available.
api_notes: Provides REST APIs, webhooks, and App Platform integrations to retrieve customer data and automate workflows.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Gladly.
rationale: Gladly offers a well-documented REST API, but obtaining credentials requires sales outreach or an enterprise subscription rather than a self-serve free sign-up.

evidence.note: Developer portal detailing REST APIs, webhooks, and Chat SDKs
Pricing and onboarding flow require demo/sales contact rather than self-serve free accounts
